steps.name: first frame
steps.assert: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; if (!g || !g.ready || g.snapshot().frame < 1) return false; const gl = g.app.world.app.renderer.gl; return !gl || !gl.isContextLost || !gl.isContextLost(); })()
steps.message: Pixi should render a first frame without a lost WebGL context

steps.name: set deterministic seed
steps.eval: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lobby-seed]'); input.value = '12345'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return input.value; })()

steps.name: founding charter state
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.seed === 12345 && s.day === 1 && s.dayLimit === 14 && s.characters === 6 && s.population === 6 && s.works === 2 && s.lumen === 10 && s.services.length === 1 && s.selectedProgram === 'canteen' && s.housingCapacity === 6; })()
steps.message: expected the First Light founding state: six residents, one Welcome Post, ten lumen, two works

steps.name: arm Tea House with the keyboard
keyboard shorthand arms Tea House
steps.message: Digit3 should arm the Tea House

steps.name: hover a free plot
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc.app; const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell('canteen'); const p = window.__falesc.worldToScreen(cell.x, cell.y); const canvas = document.querySelector('body > canvas'); canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, pointerType: 'mouse', pointerId: 9 })); window.__hoverWasVisible = g.world.hoverGhost.visible; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerleave', { bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse', pointerId: 9 })); return { shown: window.__hoverWasVisible, cleared: g.world.hoverCellKey === null }; })()

steps.name: hover preview shown and cleared
steps.message: expected a ghost preview while hovering a free plot and a cleared highlight after leaving

steps.name: open canteen build modal on a free cell
steps.eval: (() => { const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell('canteen'); window.__falesc.app.onWorldTap(cell.x, cell.y); return cell; })()

steps.name: canteen is pending
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); const c = s.services.find((service) => service.programId === 'canteen'); return s.services.length === 2 && c && c.state === 'PENDING' && s.works === 1 && s.lumen === 6; })()
steps.message: expected one PENDING Canteen, one work left, and the cost paid

steps.name: report has economy and needs
steps.assert: (() => { const r = window.__falesc.snapshot().report; return r && r.day === 1 && typeof r.contributions === 'number' && typeof r.upkeep === 'number' && r.contributions >= r.upkeep; })()
steps.message: the evening report should carry contributions and upkeep

steps.name: canteen opened overnight
steps.assert: (() => { const c = window.__falesc.snapshot().services.find((service) => service.programId === 'canteen'); return c && c.state === 'ACTIVE' && window.__falesc.snapshot().works === 2; })()
steps.message: construction should resolve at the start of the next day

steps.name: dismiss day 2 bulletin
steps.eval: (() => { const app = window.__falesc.app; if (app.bulletinModal.isOpen) app.bulletinModal.hide(); return !app.bulletinModal.isOpen; })()

steps.name: resident card explains a person
steps.assert: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('[data-testid=resident-modal]').textContent; return text.includes('Devotion') && text.includes('Home') && text.includes('Last choice'); })()
steps.message: the resident card should show needs, home, devotion and last choice

steps.name: residents visited the canteen
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); const c = s.services.find((service) => service.programId === 'canteen'); return s.report.visits > 0 && c.visits > 0 && s.residents.some((resident) => resident.lastChoice && resident.lastChoice.reason.includes('Canteen')); })()
steps.message: a resident should choose the Canteen, enter it, and leave a why line

steps.name: dismiss day 3 bulletin
steps.eval: (() => { const app = window.__falesc.app; if (app.bulletinModal.isOpen) app.bulletinModal.hide(); return !app.bulletinModal.isOpen; })()

steps.name: zoom out to map overview
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; const w = g.app.world; w.camera.zoom = w.camera.minZoom; w.camera.position.x = w.MAP_WIDTH / 2; w.camera.position.y = w.MAP_HEIGHT / 2; w.camera.updateTransform(); return { zoom: w.camera.zoom }; })()

steps.name: restore camera
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__falesc; const w = g.app.world; const home = w.homeSector; w.camera.zoom = 1; w.camera.position.x = home.centerX; w.camera.position.y = home.centerY; w.camera.updateTransform(); return true; })()

steps.name: open build modal again
steps.eval: (() => { const cell = window.__falesc.findFreeCell('tea_house'); window.__falesc.app.onWorldTap(cell.x, cell.y); return cell; })()

steps.name: modal is closed after ending
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__falesc.snapshot(); return s.state === 'END' && s.buildModalOpen === false; })()
steps.message: ending the charter must dismiss an open build prompt
